entries.title: Acts 17:1
segments: And traveling through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a synagogue of the Jews.

entries.title: Acts 17:2
segments: And according to Paul's custom, he went in to them and reasoned with them out of the Scriptures on three sabbaths,

entries.title: Acts 17:3
segments: opening and setting forth that Christ must have suffered, and to have risen again from [the] dead; and that this Jesus whom I preach to you is Christ.

entries.title: Acts 17:4
segments: And some of them believed and joined themselves to Paul and Silas, both a great multitude of the worshiping Greeks, and not a few of the chief women.

entries.title: Acts 17:5
segments: But the disobeying Jews becoming jealous, and having taken aside some wicked men of the market-loafers, and gathering a crowd, they set all the city in an uproar. And coming on the house of Jason, [they] sought to bring them out to the mob.

entries.title: Acts 17:6
segments: And not finding them, they drew Jason and certain brothers before the city judges, crying, These who have turned the world upside down have come here too,

entries.title: Acts 17:7
segments: whom Jason has received. And these all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus.

entries.title: Acts 17:8
segments: And hearing these things, they troubled the crowd and the city judge.

entries.title: Acts 17:9
segments: And taking security from Jason and from the rest, they let them go.

entries.title: Acts 17:10
segments: And the brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Berea. They, when they arrived, went into the synagogue of the Jews.

entries.title: Acts 17:11
segments: And these were more noble than those of Thessalonica, in that [they received] the Word with all readiness of mind and searched the Scriptures daily [to see] if those things [were so].

entries.title: Acts 17:12
segments: Therefore many of them believed, and quite a few of honorable Greek women and men.

entries.title: Acts 17:13
segments: But when the Jews from Thessalonica knew that the Word of God was preached by Paul at Berea, they came there also and stirred up the people.

entries.title: Acts 17:14
segments: And then immediately the brothers sent Paul away to go towards the sea, but both Silas and Timothy stayed there.

entries.title: Acts 17:15
segments: And those conducting Paul brought him to Athens. And receiving a command to Silas and Timothy to come to him with all speed, they departed.

entries.title: Acts 17:16
segments: But awaiting them in Athens, Paul's spirit was pained within him, seeing city full of idols.

entries.title: Acts 17:17
segments: Then indeed he addressed the Jews in the synagogue, and those worshiping, and daily in the market, to those happening to be [there].

entries.title: Acts 17:18
segments: And certain philosophers from the Epicureans and from the Stoics met him. And some said, What will this babbler say? And others said, He seems to be an announcer of foreign demons (because he preached Jesus and the resurrection to them).

entries.title: Acts 17:19
segments: And taking hold of him, they led [him] to the Areopagus, saying, Are we able to know what [is] this new doctrine of which you speak?

entries.title: Acts 17:20
segments: For you bring certain strange things to our ears, therefore we are minded to know what these things mean.

entries.title: Acts 17:21
segments: (For all the Athenians and strangers who were [there] spent their time in nothing else except to tell or to hear something newer.)

entries.title: Acts 17:22
segments: And standing in [the] middle of the Areopagus, Paul said, Men, Athenians, I see that you [are] fearful of gods in everything.

entries.title: Acts 17:23
segments: For [as I] passed by and saw the things you worship, I also found an altar with this inscription: TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Not knowing then whom you worship, I make Him known to you.

entries.title: Acts 17:24
segments: The God who made the world and all things in it, since He is Lord of Heaven and earth, does not dwell in temples made with hands.

entries.title: Acts 17:25
segments: Nor is served with men's hands, [as though] He needed anything, [since] He gives life and breath and all things to all.

entries.title: Acts 17:26
segments: And He has made all nations of men of one blood to dwell on all the face of the earth, ordaining fore-appointed seasons and boundaries of their dwelling,

entries.title: Acts 17:27
segments: to seek the Lord, if perhaps they might feel after Him and find Him, though indeed [He] is not far from each one of us.

entries.title: Acts 17:28
segments: For in Him we live and move and have our being, as also certain of your own poets have said, For we are also His offspring.

entries.title: Acts 17:29
segments: Then being offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like gold or silver or stone, engraved by art and man's imagination.

entries.title: Acts 17:30
segments: Truly, then, God overlooking the times of ignorance, now He strictly commands all men everywhere to repent,

entries.title: Acts 17:31
segments: because He has appointed a day in which He is going to judge the world in righteousness by a Man whom He appointed, having given proof to all [by] raising Him from [the] dead.

entries.title: Acts 17:32
segments: And hearing [of] a resurrection of [the] dead, some indeed mocked; and others said, We will hear you again concerning this.

entries.title: Acts 17:33
segments: And so Paul departed from among them.

entries.title: Acts 17:34
segments: But certain men joined themselves to him and believed; among whom [were] Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
